reviewer: Independent research and subsequent source-content reviewer; no teaching-page authorship
scope: Ten public static, unscored Topic Guides AC9E1LY06–LY15 only. This gate approves the evidence and plan for drafting, not final content or publication.

AC9E1LY06.evidence: Current completed 75-item source-method ledger, actual composition/revision/image-caption task families; LE05 reusable narrative methods. Later completed gate supersedes candidate checkpoint.
AC9E1LY06.plan: Three entry focuses preserve report/opinion/recount, actual meaningful visual-caption composition, and rereading/editing. Retained six detailed sections supply examples and checking.
AC9E1LY06.boundary: Supply topic facts or a familiar observation; accept defensible opinions. Digital creation requires actual created images/captions on screen, not only identifying a good caption.

AC9E1LY07.evidence: Actual 75-task five-focus ledger with complete Oak transcripts, self-contained external oral presentation tasks and bounded cue-sheet visual observations.
AC9E1LY07.plan: Three entry focuses combine planning, purposeful details/vocabulary, and rehearsal/actual delivery; seven retained sections retain purpose, gesture and voice examples.
AC9E1LY07.boundary: Written planning and recognition are prerequisites, not delivery evidence. No fixed accent, eye contact, standing, loudness, confidence or words-per-minute requirement. Do not infer unobserved books, model paintings or heard audio.

AC9E1LY08.evidence: Actual 30 practical selected writing-block ledger, source movement/ruled models, government guidance on functional grasp, school-specific forms and Year 1 case use.
AC9E1LY08.plan: Three entry focuses separate comfortable controlled movement, actual lower/capital word production, and line/gap/legibility checking; five strong retained sections. Historical two-focus product exception is not a ban on three useful public entry topics.
AC9E1LY08.boundary: Actual unjoined handwriting using the school model; functional comfortable grasp rather than a universal tripod. No joining requirement or inference of grip from the final page.

AC9E1LY09.evidence: Current QA plus full reusable Foundation segmentation/blending and ordered-sound methods; Year 1 LY04 ledger distinguishes sound-letter representations.
AC9E1LY09.plan: Order spoken phonemes, preserve beginning clusters, preserve ending clusters and distinguish digraphs. Seven retained sections provide worked segmentation.
AC9E1LY09.boundary: Sound count is not letter count; keep each cluster sound, no added schwa. Oral stimulus/response required for the phonological demand; printed scaffolding is explicitly separate.

AC9E1LY10.evidence: Original QA genuinely lacked a complete externally inspected manipulation method. Gap now closed by full LiteracyHub Module 3 Add/Drop/Swap/Move transcript, Reading Universe explicit manipulation method, and complete cached Victorian government focused-teaching method.
AC9E1LY10.plan: Three useful focuses cover addition in different positions, initial/medial/final substitution, and deletion/reblending. Seven retained sections plus new given examples can now be drafted from sufficient methods.
AC9E1LY10.boundary: One syllable, up to four phonemes; initial/interior/final changes stated exactly. Oral target before print confirmation; counters represent sounds. Older Victorian tasks are method transfer only, not Year 1 authority.

AC9E1LY11.evidence: Year 1 LY04 actual ledger and reusable Foundation spelling methods, bounded Year 3 actual open/closed and common-pattern observations.
AC9E1LY11.plan: Short/common-long vowel reading and writing, blends/digraphs, and familiar two-syllable blending/spelling. Seven retained sections.
AC9E1LY11.boundary: Read AND write, not selection alone. Blends and digraphs are a different classification axis from vowel length; a word can fit more than one pattern.

AC9E1LY12.evidence: Actual Year 1/Foundation sound methods plus bounded Year 3 vowel/syllable explanations, checked against exact Year 1 elaborations.
AC9E1LY12.plan: One letter/different sounds, same sound/different letters, and vowel-sound syllables are three distinct assessable ideas. Seven retained sections.
AC9E1LY12.boundary: Count spoken vowel sounds, not vowel letters; use natural Australian pronunciation and familiar examples. Do not universalise open/closed or vowel-pair generalisations.

AC9E1LY13.evidence: Full reusable Foundation spelling methods and Year 1 whole-word methods; bounded Year 3 syllable/common-pattern methods read including late correction limits.
AC9E1LY13.plan: Sound-to-pattern spelling, both parts of familiar two-syllable words, and checking blends/digraphs/standard spelling. Seven retained sections.
AC9E1LY13.boundary: Independent spelling hides the answer. Syllable segmentation does not determine rabbit double-b or every possible spelling; use taught standard forms or a reference.

AC9E1LY14.evidence: Actual Foundation 5G5/YJZ/7V2 method and preview records with explicit audio/key limits; whole-word letters, regular/unusual parts, context check and covered-model production. Bounded Year 3 contextual methods.
AC9E1LY14.plan: Build a growing familiar repertoire, read whole words in context, and write without copying then check. Seven retained sections.
AC9E1LY14.boundary: Fluency develops without a speed-only criterion. Do not guess from shape/picture/first letter or infer unheard audio targets; hidden-target dictation/covered model distinguishes production from copying.

AC9E1LY15.evidence: Actual Year 3 base/affix and regular past/plural methods including final-e/y/doubling cautions and late bounded gap notes. Official Year 1 grammatical-morpheme examples control scope.
AC9E1LY15.plan: Meaningful base versus rhyme, grammatical endings in complete sentences, and family/simple compound meaning. Seven retained sections.
AC9E1LY15.boundary: No universal -ing=present rule; complete sentence context controls tense/meaning. No Greek/Latin or broad derivational programme imported from older curriculum; do not claim full unobserved suffix coverage.

required_drafting_repairs.issue: Internal IXL process sentence in retained learner explanation.
required_drafting_repairs.required: Remove process-only equivalence wording while retaining the actual segmentation teaching.

required_drafting_repairs.issue: Vowel length, consonant blends and digraphs were presented as exclusive sorting categories.
required_drafting_repairs.required: State the sorting axis or explicitly permit overlapping labels; preserve accurate answers for words such as ship.

required_drafting_repairs.issue: Rabbit/rab-bit task implies hearing two syllables determines doubled b.
required_drafting_repairs.required: Teach/check the known standard rabbit spelling explicitly; do not infer double b merely from syllables.

required_drafting_repairs.issue: The dog is small asks which word must be recognised quickly, key The; multiple frequent words are defensible.
required_drafting_repairs.required: Specify the target/criterion or accept all justified responses, and remove speed-only implication.

required_drafting_repairs.issue: I have some apples asks which word might need extra practice, key some; learner-dependent and visible model undermines from-memory writing.
required_drafting_repairs.required: Specify a concrete target or accept individual needs; use adult dictation or explicit cover-then-write before checking.

required_drafting_repairs.issue: Helping/-ing alone is described as meaning happening now.
required_drafting_repairs.required: Use complete sentences and distinguish the grammatical construction/context; do not teach a universal ing=present rule.

ly10_independent_closure.abc_first: ABC first-pass related segmentation/onset-rime material did not itself supply the complete manipulation method. No quota research was requested.

literacyhub.inspection: Full written accessibility transcript and audio descriptions independently reopened; no media heard or played.
checked_examples: back substitute /b/ to /s/ = sack; then /s/ to /p/ = pack
sat substitute medial vowel = sit; hit/hat, pit/pat

reading_universe.inspection: Full written explicit-method page independently reopened: prerequisite segmentation/blending; sound-position language; one felt per sound; model/guided/independent oral responses; avoid schwa.
reading_universe.limit: Its suggested teaching order is a provider sequence, not a mandatory universal sequence; remaining sound examples such as see minus /s/ must not be represented as necessarily new whole words.

victorian_government.inspection: Direct retrieval returned 502. Independently recovered complete cached government method body through a domain-specific stronger search, not merely a snippet/title.
victorian_government.limit: Source is for Years 3–6; transfer only the method and checked one-syllable <=4-phoneme examples. Exclude bend→blend (five target phonemes), multisyllabic and older complexity.

review_limits: Read actual current QA decisions, accepted method/teaching records, relevant late corrections, all ten original lesson bodies and all planned retained labels. Did not claim a new exhaustive solve of every historical source or product item.

No new media/audio, child performance, cultural-source permission, commercial-product content or current app-bank certification is inferred. Existing images/models still require independent pixel review on the authored exact version.

Full source-content review of new authored prompts, answers, explanations, retained repairs and stimuli is pending. The current 10 November SOP also requires a fresh separate final risk-based reviewer, all repairs/high-risk content plus a suitable remainder sample, and actual rendered-artifact inspection.
These are public unscored prompts. This is not blind-scored-bank, human teacher, pupil trial, attainment or universal-quality certification.
